title: Explicit restricted single-complex transitions and cone comparisons
statement: For a diagram D in Over S, coefficients F with transitions phi, and an etale U over S, form the concrete fibre-product diagram and degree-zero complexes of [def-sbc-restricted-affine-coefficient-construction]. Define the complex transition to be mapCochainComplexSingleFunctor.hom followed by singleFunctor.map of rawAffineRestrictedCoefficient [def-sbc-raw-affine-restricted-cohomology]. For a cone c and a coefficient diagram H identified with the pullbacks of F by eH, define eG by restricting eH along the cone second projection, then the inverse composition comparison for that projection and the original cone leg, then the composition comparison for the restricted cone leg and the stage projection, then the inverse single-complex comparison. The pullback projection identity identifies the two composites. All maps and isomorphisms are explicit; no unproved existence witness is chosen.
